content.tagline: Healthy, radiant skin for every age
content.descriptor: Korean skincare brand with Teen and Derma product lines
about: We are Feelody, a Korean skincare brand founded by a Korean medicine doctor and mother of two. According to the company, the idea came from her own children's skin concerns, which shaped our starting goal: skincare gentle enough for a teenager and effective enough to use every day at any age.

Our range brings five products together in two lines. The Feelody Teen line covers a daily three-step routine: Day Supreme Multi Essence Sunscreen, Night Flex Calming Ampoule and Acne Wonder Bubble Foam Cleansing. The Feelody Derma line adds two home-care products for a more advanced routine: Vital Surge Skin Booster and All Day Shield Barrier Cream. Each product is built as an all-in-one formula, so a short routine still covers several skin concerns at once.

Our Teen line is manufactured to global-standard production practice (CGMP, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22716); the Derma line to ISO 22716 practice. According to our clinical testing materials, all five products completed a human skin primary irritation or stimulation test with an average response rate of 0.00%.

lines.name: Day Supreme Multi Essence Sunscreen
lines.note: An SPF50+ PA++++ sun essence from the Teen line that also works as a brightening, moisturizing step. According to the company, the spreadable essence texture leaves no white cast, and the product completed a human skin primary irritation test and a sensitive-skin suitability test with an average response rate of 0.00%. Key ingredients: hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, jojoba oil, aloe barbadensis and melia azadirachta extracts.

lines.name: Night Flex Calming Ampoule
lines.note: A five-in-one ampoule from the Teen line for moisturizing, calming, brightening, pore care and skin-barrier support in one evening step. According to the company, it completed a human skin primary irritation test and a sensitive-skin suitability test with an average response rate of 0.00%. Key ingredients: hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, panthenol, centella asiatica complex and betaine.

lines.name: Acne Wonder Bubble Foam Cleansing
lines.note: A dense bubble foam cleanser from the Teen line built on an AHA, BHA and PHA complex for pore and acne-prone skin care, balanced to a slightly acidic pH 4.5. According to the company, it completed a human skin primary stimulation test with an average response rate of 0.00%. Key ingredients: centella asiatica complex, vitamin C and vitamins B12/E.

lines.name: Vital Surge Skin Booster
lines.note: A first-essence booster from the Derma line built around aloe leaf water, a seven-hyaluronic-acid complex, PDRN and exosome ingredients. According to the company's clinical testing materials, a single use showed an 8.2% improvement in skin barrier strength, a 159% improvement in moisturizing and a 37% decrease in visible dead skin cells.

lines.name: All Day Shield Barrier Cream
lines.note: A finishing cream from the Derma line, sharing the Skin Booster's aloe leaf water, hyaluronic acid, PDRN and exosome base, with queensland nut oil added. According to the company's clinical testing materials, a single use showed a 9.7% improvement in skin barrier strength, a 128% improvement in moisturizing and a 45% decrease in visible dead skin cells.
